about: MEP point rules by ROLE of an object. Offsets from the anchor: u along the run from the anchor CENTRE (+ = + run axis), z above the floor (centre of box / stub), v from the anchor BACK face into the room. A project file maps roles to objects. status: SOURCE = manufacturer document (source names it), PLANNING = our default until a document or a decision, DECISION = Andriy. Points without a position (schedule only) have no u/z. Island (Andriy 2026-10-15): every utility of the cooktop inside the cooktop cabinet, on its back panel, on one line.

1/2" CW, dual-outlet angle stop (faucet + RO feed).

points.item: Downdraft Thermador UCVM36XS + in-line blower VTI1FZ
points.req: 120 V 15 A receptacle for the downdraft (30" cord). VTI1FZ 120 V on a dedicated 15 A breaker, wired from the downdraft.

8" round RIGID duct (no flex) from UCVM36XS down through the floor to VTI1FZ in the tech room, then to an exterior wall cap with backdraft damper. Max 50 ft (15 m) equivalent length. Gas cooktop: seal kit UCV36ST and min. 27 sq in (174 cm2) opening in the toe-kick AND the cabinet base. No recirculation.

Downdraft 600 CFM with a gas appliance in the house: make-up air required (CRC M1503, above 400 CFM). Air from the tech room below, motorized damper interlocked with the downdraft (UCVM36XS make-up air damper wiring p.22). GC + AHJ confirm.
